notes.text: This lesson teaches capstone: production deliverable as a real internship skill. Students learn the concept, why teams use it, how it fits into the project, what can go wrong, and how to verify the result. The goal is understanding plus independent application, not memorizing definitions.

Your mentor assigns you a realistic Technical Business Analyst Internship task focused on capstone: production deliverable. The project uses stakeholders, requirements, process models, data/API analysis, acceptance criteria and UAT.

Start with the problem, identify the expected outcome, choose the appropriate approach, perform the work, validate it, and improve it based on evidence. For capstone: production deliverable, the student should understand both the mechanism and the reason the team would choose it.
Why It Matters in Real Work

An intern's work must fit into a larger system. Capstone: Production Deliverable therefore has to be understandable, reviewable and safe to maintain. The student should consider requirements, dependencies, failure cases, quality and the relevant concerns of the product / professional tech discipline.
